title: The game is now in English
text: Menus, items, skills, the demon compendium, quests, story and NPC dialogue are translated. Report text that reads wrong to the server admin.

title: Extra shortcut bars, keys and macros
text: Up to 6 more shortcut bars, a key for every slot and macros. Set them up with KeyConfigTool.exe in the game folder.

title: Quality of life
text: @sort and @deposit chat commands, bigger item stacks, a smarter partner demon and a reworked stagger system that rewards dodging and countering.

title: Player portal
text: Create your account and see your characters, stats, alignment and demons on the player portal (link on the left).
